Coram : INDIRA BANERJEE*, A.S. BOPANNA
Admiralty (Jurisdiction and Settlement of Maritime Claims) Act, 2017 – s.14 – Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 – Or.1 r.10(2) – Commercial Courts Act, 2015 – Whether an appeal lies to the Commercial Appellate Division of the High Court the Commercial Division (Single Bench) of the same High Court for addition of a party, in an Admiralty Suit governed by the Admiralty Act – Held: No – An order for addition of a party u/Or.1 r.10(2) of the CPC is not appealable u/s.14 of the Admiralty Act –Maritime Laws.
Decision Date : 23-09-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6897/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
